title: Steamed Algerian Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and healthy Algerian-inspired lentil pilaf, made with steamed lentils and served with a side of light pilaf.

ingredients.name: Steamed lentils
ingredients.notes: Rinse and drain well before using

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the steamed lentils, Algerian spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan.
Stir to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked light pilaf to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
